cluster_features: cluster features using FAISS k-means and assign hard labels to a dataset split
run_cluster_features_cli: run the cluster features CLI with hydra config overrides for features path and number of clusters
get_data_features_for_k_means: get a sampled subset of extracted features from disk for k-means clustering
get_image_paths: get the list of image paths for a given dataset and split
create_dataset_split_labels: create a new classification dataset with cluster labels from extracted features and k-means centroids
